annotations.title: Player Props Research, Model & Cheat Sheet (Pro)

description: Use this when the user asks about a player's prop lines, how often he clears a line, book-by-book prices, or today's prop board. Returns, for a player_id, his upcoming lines, book-by-book odds and moves, line comparisons (averages, L5/L10/L20/season hit rates, model probability), his over/under/push record against closing lines and alternate ladders; without one, today's prop board (model probability and market edge, optionally for one game_id) and the daily cheat sheet. Requires Keel Stats Pro. Research only: it never gives a pick.

date.description: Optional date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the NBA daily prop board.

game_id.description: Optional numeric game ID to filter the daily prop board to a single game.

player_id.description: Optional numeric player ID to inspect his upcoming lines, book-by-book odds, line comparisons, closing-line record, and ladders. Omit for the daily prop board and cheat sheet.

stat.description: Optional stat code for the daily board or book-by-book view (e.g. NBA: "pts", "reb", "ast", "tpm", "pra"; NFL: "passing_yards", "rushing_yards", "receiving_yards", "receptions").
